body:
## Problem

With the LP swap merged (#382), CostateDualSolver dominates solver CPU: buildHessian is 42% of execution samples and choleskySolve another 20%. The Hessian math itself is analytical and already hoisted (#378); the waste is iteration volume. Traced on gh283-j925-farseed: 6,790 dual solves, 559k Newton iterations, and 77% of the solves burn the full MAX_ITER=100 with projected-gradient residuals ending at a median of 8.5e-2 against GRAD_TOL=1e-8. Each of those 100 iterations rebuilds the O(walls^2 x ticks) Hessian and refactors the O(walls^3) Cholesky.

These are mostly free-start chain-scan rungs (140 anchor thetas x pattern rounds x margin bisection and rungs) probing infeasible or degenerate anchors where the damped Newton plateaus. The existing divergence bail only fires while the best residual exceeds 4.0 (DIVERGE_PGRES); the capped population plateaus in the 5e-3 to 0.9 range, below the gate, and grinds to the cap.

## Task

Add a relative-stall bail: when the best residual has stopped improving (DIVERGE_REL-style) for a stall window while still far above tolerance (for example above 1e4 x GRAD_TOL), break and return the current iterate as a normal Result. It must NOT set lastStalled (jointLadder treats that flag as skip-the-branch); a bailed solve returns the same monotone-in-dual-value iterate the cap would have returned, just earlier.

Measure first, kill-audit style: instrument solve/iteration/cap counts per corpus, prototype the bail behind a temporary switch, and gate on the full sweep (104/104, no capture meaningfully slower) plus :core:check -PslowTests. Trajectories may shift for the capped population (their recovered candidates feed rung checks); results that stay feasible are acceptable per the standing ruling, lost solves are not.

## Appendix

Adjacent but separate: the 140-theta x pattern-round rescan structure in the free-start pipeline multiplies these solves (measured under issue 380 target 3); reducing the scan volume is a second, structural lever. Sweep baseline after #382: 25.1 s at 104/104, slowTests ~2m40s.
title: feat: stop the dual Newton loop from grinding non-converging solves to the iteration cap
